newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hong Kong Yip's Pota says IPO 6.7 times subscribed.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong Yip's Pota says IPO 6.7 times subscribed.

text.p: Souvenir maker Yip's Pota International Co Ltd said on Tuesday its initial public offering (IPO) in Hong Kong was 6.7 times subscribed.

Yip's Pota said in a statement it had received applications for 303.37 million shares compared with 45 million shares available for public subscription. It said another 5.0 million shares for staff were fully allotted on a preferential basis.
Dealing in the company's shares is expected to begin on January 20, it said.

Yip's Pota offered 50 million shares at HK$1.00 each in an IPO, raising net proceeds of about HK$40 million to fund the purchase of a manufacturing plant and machinery, to repay bank borrowings and for working capital.
